briefdescription.para: Reads an image from the specified file.

detaileddescription.para: The image format is detected from the file header, not the file extension.

filename
Path to read the image from.
A CVL_UINT8 matrix containing the decoded image, or an empty matrix on failure.
See cvl_format_t.

briefdescription.para: Writes an image to the specified file.

detaileddescription.para: The image format is determined from the file extension.

entry.para: 1 channel, CVL_UINT8, pixels must be 0 or 255
CVL_UINT8, 1 or 3 channels, no padding between pixels

detaileddescription.para:
filename
Path to write the image to.
img
Image to write.
0 on success, 1 on failure.
See cvl_format_t.
